narr: During the evening of July 10, 2021, an upper-level disturbance pushed into the area from the northwest. As a result, a line of thunderstorms developed and pushed across areas along and north of Interstate 40. Later that night the storms stalled across the Memphis metropolitan area causing some flash flooding.
ev: The intersection of Highway 64 and Airline Road was flooded.
